iti110:2.1: Carato ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā vyāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā;
iti110:2.2: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhu adhivāseti na-ppajahati na vinodeti na vyantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
iti110:2.3: caraṃ pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottappī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyo ti vuccati.
iti110:3.1: Ṭhitassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā vyāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā;
iti110:3.2: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhu adhivāseti na-ppajahati na vinodeti na vyantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
iti110:3.3: ṭhito pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottappī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyo ti vuccati. --
iti110:4.1: Nisinnassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā vyāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā;
iti110:4.2: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhu adhivāseti na-ppajahati na vinodeti na vyantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
iti110:4.3: nisinno pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottappī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyo ti vuccati. --
iti110:5.1: Sayānassa ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno jāgarassa uppajjati kāmavitakko vā vyāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā;
iti110:5.2: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhu adhivāseti na-ppajahati na vinodeti na vyantikaroti na anabhāvaṃ gameti,
iti110:5.3: sayāno pi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro evaṃbhūto anātāpī anottappī satataṃ samitaṃ kusīto hīnaviriyo ti vuccati. --
iti110:6.1: Carato ce pi bhikkhave bhikkhuno uppajjati kāmavitakko vā vyāpādavitakko vā vihiṃsāvitakko vā;
iti110:6.2: tañce bhikkhave bhikkhu nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti vyantikaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti,
iti110:6.3: caraṃ pi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitatto ti vuccati.
